issues.legal_issue: The Collector must conduct the inquiry into objections to a land acquisition notification under Section 15(2) and forward the record and recommendations to the appropriate Government; the Collector cannot delegate that function absent authority under the Act.

The appropriate Government must make the final decision on objections under Section 15(3), and the Collector cannot exercise that power unless the statutory proviso deeming the Collector to be the appropriate Government applies.
Non-compliance with the mandatory requirements for hearing and deciding objections under Sections 15(2) and 15(3) vitiates the land acquisition proceedings and the resulting award.
A final award made while a challenge to the acquisition proceedings is pending does not render the challenge infructuous where the mandatory hearing of objections has not been complied with.
